design: Fixed initial inventory, no purchases or replacements after day one. Hybrid reserves m*max(0,5-A-1) free accounts for future setups, where A counts distinct currently occupied signals. Target=min(cap,max(m,free-reserve)); allocate available accounts in descending current headroom. Current minimum participation takes priority when depleted inventory cannot support both current minimum and future reservations. No future exits or P&L used to choose targets. Prior controls must reproduce numerically and by per-trade account assignment.
